original_test_intent: Upgrade or downgrade the specified GPU firmware through the platform OOB controller, perform required cold activation, and demonstrate the requested active version plus complete GPU/PCIe/driver and management recovery.
original_method: Map SUT/BMC/HGX and GPU UUID/BDF/board to OOB target; establish current/target version and direction; verify signed image, compatibility, task semantics and rollback; preserve baseline and drain jobs; upload once after explicit approval, follow returned task, operator performs activation/power cycle; verify per-GPU active firmware, host/BMC reconnect, PCIe/driver health and logs.
manual_activity: Firmware owner identifies GPU/target and direction and approves image/recovery; operator controls flash and power window; agent may perform only the sanctioned OOB transaction.
required_inputs: GPU UUID/BDF/board/SKU to BMC/HMC target mapping
Signed image/hash with current/target versions and upgrade/downgrade direction
OOB UpdateService/task/activation behavior and TLS credentials
Rollback/vendor recovery, job drain, PDU/console and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Never infer a physical GPU from HGX_0
Reject unspecified direction, unsigned image or incompatible board
Monitor only the returned task; do not assume Task 1
Require explicit approval before upload and cold power action
Stop on target/status/version/link/management anomaly and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Capture baseline and execute one approved OOB upload
Follow task and collect activation/readback/platform health
engineer_actions: Resolve GPU/HGX mapping and approve direction/image/rollback
Authorize flash, activation and recovery ownership

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic OOB tooling does not preserve the source Redfish target/task or distinguish GPU from HMC/FPGA; literal curl credentials/TLS bypass are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using authenticated vendor-approved OOB UpdateService, upload the signed image to the mapped GPU target, follow the returned task, then after authorized activation verify per-GPU active firmware and PCIe/driver health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OOB, upgrade/downgrade and power-cycle coverage are retained; direction, target and recovery are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind a per-GPU immutable update plan to the OOB request/task and record staged versus active versions, cold-power event and independent host recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes direction, physical target and recovery testable instead of accepting one aggregate inventory version.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: In-band nvflash success cannot substitute for BMC/HMC OOB control-path coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OOB updates can continue while the host is unavailable; task ownership and abort/recovery semantics must be known before upload.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner determines OOB target granularity, supported downgrade path, active/staged bank meaning and vendor recovery.
expected_evidence: Signed image/hash, current/target versions and direction
Sanitized OOB request, returned task URI/messages and terminal state
Per-GPU active version, lspci/driver/NVLink and SEL/dmesg/BMC health

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row269 Wistron-NV GPU-00262-V002: map the exact GPU UUID/BDF/board target behind HGX_0 and select upgrade or downgrade direction/current-target versions; approve signed image, compatibility, OOB task/activation semantics, rollback and cold-power/OOB recovery.

review_improvement: Makes the OOB path, direction and physical GPU traceable and requires active-version plus full host/management recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: OOB control can stage firmware independently of host state, so upload completion and host-visible activation are separate checkpoints. A composite HGX target may affect multiple GPUs or board controllers, and downgrade compatibility can differ from upgrade. Successful recovery therefore requires both controller-side task/version evidence and host-side enumeration, link and driver verification after cold activation.
